shared_elements: bearded male head with elaborate coiffure/headgear
figures holding objects in outstretched hands
garment with patterned/fringed hem rendered by incised lines
rosette motif (border rosettes in A, rosette-like held object in B)
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures with carefully rendered beards/hair, patterned fringed garments and hands extended holding objects, and both include rosette forms, which is a fairly specific set of shared conventions. But A is a horizontal procession scene of small figures leading a camel beneath a rosette frieze, while B is a single monumental winged figure filling the field — the wings, the isolation and the vertical monumental format have no counterpart in A.
